01 / About Aitia

Creative thinking.
Technical curiosity.

Aitia Media brings design, digital marketing and technology into one creative practice. From a brand's visual identity to the website, content and workflows behind it, we connect the pieces of a digital presence.

The work draws on Saurav Dhawale's experience across graphic design, social media, SEO, marketing strategy, web development, AI and automation.

Our approach is practical: understand your business, research the audience, shape the strategy, build the solution and keep improving.

04 / A few answers

Before we begin.

What can we create together?

Brand identities, social content, marketing videos, websites, digital tools and AI-assisted workflows. Share your idea and we can work out the right scope.

Where can I see the work?

The Work collection links to original creative files in Google Drive and digital projects from Saurav's portfolio.

How do I start a project?

Connect with Aitia Media on LinkedIn and share your business, what you need, your timeline and budget. The conversation starts with understanding the brief.

How are pricing and timelines decided?

They depend on the scope and deliverables. Share a brief so the requirements can be discussed before the project begins.
